crossRefs.note: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is…
Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
translations.bsb: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
translations.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
translations.asv: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
